izoh: savollar: vinyetka/savol/javoblar inglizcha, izoh o'zbekcha (200 belgigacha), togri - to'g'ri javob raqami (0 dan). faktlar: sarlavha va bandlar inglizcha (kartochkada), izoh o'zbekcha. maslahatlar: o'zbekcha. Tekshirish: python usmle_tekshir.py

savollar.vinyetka: A 24-year-old tall man with long fingers and lens subluxation (upward and outward) collapses while playing basketball. He had a diastolic murmur at the left sternal border.
savollar.savol: What is the most likely underlying defect?
savollar.izoh: Marfan sindromi: FBN1 (fibrillin-1), AD. Linza yuqori-tashqariga siljiydi, aorta ildizi kengayadi -> aortal regurgitatsiya va disseksiya. Gomosistinuriyada linza pastga siljiydi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 62-year-old man starts a new drug for heart failure. Two weeks later he develops painful breast enlargement. Potassium is 5.6 mEq/L.
savollar.savol: Which drug was most likely started?
savollar.izoh: Spironolakton androgen retseptorlarini ham bloklaydi -> ginekomastiya. Ikkalasi ham giperkaliemiya beradi, lekin eplerenon selektivroq, ginekomastiya kam.

savollar.vinyetka: A 19-year-old college student has fever, headache and neck stiffness. A petechial rash appears on the legs. CSF Gram stain shows gram-negative diplococci.
savollar.savol: Which virulence factor is mainly responsible for the rash and shock?
savollar.izoh: Neisseria meningitidis: LOS (endotoksin) DIC, petexiya va shokni chaqiradi (Waterhouse-Friderichsen). Kapsula fagotsitozdan himoya qiladi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 6-month-old infant has hypoglycemia, lactic acidosis, hepatomegaly and doll-like face. Glucagon does not raise blood glucose.
savollar.savol: Which enzyme is most likely deficient?
savollar.izoh: Von Gierke (GSD I): glyukoza-6-fosfataza yetishmasligi. Og'ir och qoringa gipoglikemiya, laktat, urat va TG oshadi. Glyukagonga javob yo'q.

savollar.vinyetka: A 55-year-old smoker has hypercalcemia, low PTH, and a central-free peripheral lung mass. Biopsy shows keratin pearls and intercellular bridges.
savollar.savol: What is the most likely cause of the hypercalcemia?
javoblar: PTHrP secretion by squamous cell carcinoma
Ectopic ACTH from small cell carcinoma
savollar.izoh: Yassi hujayrali karsinoma (keratin 'marvaridlari') PTHrP ishlab chiqaradi -> giperkalsiemiya, PTH past. Odatda markaziy joylashadi, chekish bilan bog'liq.

savollar.vinyetka: A 7-year-old boy has cola-colored urine and periorbital edema 2 weeks after a sore throat. Blood pressure is elevated. C3 is low.
savollar.savol: What would electron microscopy most likely show?
javoblar: Effacement of podocyte foot processes only
savollar.izoh: Poststreptokokk glomerulonefrit: tomoq infeksiyasidan 2-3 hafta keyin. EM da subepitelial 'do'ngchalar', C3 pasayadi. Bolalarda odatda o'tib ketadi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 68-year-old man has resting tremor that improves with movement, cogwheel rigidity and shuffling gait. Autopsy later shows eosinophilic intracytoplasmic inclusions.
savollar.savol: Which protein forms these inclusions?
savollar.izoh: Parkinson kasalligi: substantia nigra dofaminergik neyronlari yo'qoladi. Lewi tanachalari - alfa-sinuklein. Tau - Pick va Altsgeymer chigallari.

savollar.vinyetka: A 3-year-old boy has recurrent catalase-positive infections (S. aureus, Aspergillus). Dihydrorhodamine test is abnormal.
savollar.savol: Which enzyme is defective?
savollar.izoh: Surunkali granulematoz kasallik: NADPH oksidaza defekti, 'respirator portlash' yo'q. Katalaza-musbat mikroblar xavfli. DHR testi (avval NBT) anormal.

savollar.vinyetka: A 34-year-old woman has weight gain, purple striae and hypertension. Low-dose dexamethasone does not suppress cortisol; high-dose does. ACTH is elevated.
savollar.savol: What is the most likely cause?
javoblar: Ectopic ACTH from small cell carcinoma
savollar.izoh: ACTH yuqori + yuqori dozali deksametazon bostiradi = gipofiz adenomasi (Kushing kasalligi). Ektopik ACTH bostirilmaydi, buyrak usti o'smasida ACTH past.

savollar.vinyetka: A 25-year-old African American man develops dark urine and anemia after starting primaquine. Smear shows bite cells and Heinz bodies.
savollar.savol: What is the underlying enzyme deficiency?
savollar.izoh: G6PD yetishmasligi (X-bog'liq): oksidant (primakin, sulfanilamidlar, fava loviya) -> qon tomir ichi gemolizi, Heinz tanachalari va 'tishlangan' hujayralar.

savollar.vinyetka: A patient on warfarin for atrial fibrillation starts a new antibiotic for a UTI. Three days later, INR rises to 6.5 with gum bleeding.
savollar.savol: Which antibiotic most likely caused this interaction?
savollar.izoh: TMP-SMX CYP2C9 ni ingibitsiya qiladi -> varfarin darajasi va INR oshadi. Rifampin aksincha induktor - INR pasayadi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 2-year-old boy has developmental delay, self-mutilation (biting lips and fingers), gout and orange crystals in diapers.
savollar.savol: Which enzyme is deficient?
savollar.izoh: Lesch-Nyhan sindromi: HGPRT yetishmasligi (X-bog'liq retsessiv). Purinlar qayta ishlatilmaydi -> siydik kislotasi oshadi, o'zini jarohatlash, distoniya.

savollar.vinyetka: A climber ascends to 4500 m. After 2 days his arterial PaO2 is low and he is hyperventilating.
savollar.savol: Which acid-base disturbance is expected, and how do the kidneys compensate?
savollar.izoh: Balandlikda gipoksiya -> giperventilyatsiya -> respirator alkaloz. Buyraklar bikarbonat chiqarishni oshiradi (atsetazolamid shu jarayonni tezlashtiradi).

savollar.vinyetka: A man develops watery diarrhea after eating reheated fried rice. Symptoms began 2 hours after the meal with vomiting.
savollar.savol: Which organism is most likely responsible?
savollar.izoh: Bacillus cereus: isitilgan guruch, sporalar tirik qoladi. Emetik shakl (oldindan hosil bo'lgan toksin) 1-6 soatda qusish beradi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 45-year-old woman has fatigue and pruritus. Alkaline phosphatase is markedly elevated. Antimitochondrial antibodies are positive.
savollar.savol: What is the most likely diagnosis?
savollar.izoh: Birlamchi biliar xolangit: o'rta yoshli ayollar, antimitoxondrial antitanalar (AMA), ishqoriy fosfataza oshadi. Davolash - ursodeoksixol kislota.

savollar.vinyetka: A 30-year-old woman has a mid-systolic click followed by a late systolic murmur at the apex. The murmur occurs earlier on standing.
savollar.savol: What is the most likely diagnosis?
savollar.izoh: Mitral klapan prolapsi: sistolik 'klik' + kech sistolik shovqin. Turish (preload kamayadi) klik va shovqinni oldinga suradi. Miksomatoz degeneratsiya.

savollar.vinyetka: A patient with tuberculosis on a 4-drug regimen develops numbness and tingling in both feet.
savollar.savol: Which supplement could have prevented this adverse effect?
savollar.izoh: Izoniazid B6 (piridoksin) yetishmasligini chaqiradi -> periferik neyropatiya. Profilaktika uchun piridoksin beriladi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 50-year-old man dies 2 days after a myocardial infarction. Histology of the infarct shows coagulative necrosis with a dense neutrophilic infiltrate.
savollar.savol: At approximately what time after infarction is this picture typical?
savollar.izoh: MI dan 1-3 kun keyin: koagulyatsion nekroz + neytrofillar (fibrinoz perikardit xavfi). 3-14 kun - makrofaglar va granulyatsiya, yorilish xavfi eng yuqori.

savollar.vinyetka: A patient has weakness of the right arm and leg, loss of vibration sense on the right, and his tongue deviates to the left when protruded.
savollar.savol: Where is the lesion most likely located?
savollar.izoh: Medial medulla sindromi (chap): o'ng tana gemiparezi (piramida), o'ng proprioseptsiya (medial lemnisk) va til CHAPga og'adi (XII nerv - shikastlangan tomonga).

savollar.vinyetka: A chronic alcoholic is given IV dextrose in the emergency department and develops confusion, ophthalmoplegia and ataxia.
savollar.savol: Deficiency of which vitamin is responsible?
savollar.izoh: Vernike ensefalopatiyasi: B1 (tiamin) yetishmasligi. Glyukozani tiamindan OLDIN berish uni kuchaytiradi. Uchlik: konfuziya, oftalmoplegiya, ataksiya.

savollar.vinyetka: A 58-year-old man has crushing chest pain for 40 minutes. ECG shows ST elevation in II, III and aVF. BP 82/50 mmHg, clear lungs, elevated JVP.
savollar.savol: Which drug should be AVOIDED in this patient?
savollar.izoh: Pastki MI + gipotenziya + toza o'pka + JVP yuqori = o'ng qorincha infarkti. Preloadga bog'liq: nitratlar xavfli (gipotenziya), suyuqlik beriladi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 70-year-old woman has fever, cough and confusion. RR 32/min, BP 85/55, BUN 28 mg/dL. Chest X-ray shows right lower lobe consolidation.
savollar.savol: What is the most appropriate site of care?
savollar.izoh: CURB-65: konfuziya, BUN>19, RR>=30, AQB past, yosh>=65 = 5 ball. 3+ ball va gipotenziya - ICU. Pnevmoniya og'irligini doim CURB-65 bilan baholang.

savollar.vinyetka: A 32-year-old woman at 34 weeks of gestation has BP 168/112, headache and visual disturbances. Urine protein 3+. Platelets 85,000.
savollar.savol: What is the most important next step to prevent seizures?
savollar.izoh: Og'ir preeklampsiya: tutqanoq profilaktikasi - magniy sulfat. Bosim uchun labetalol/gidralazin/nifedipin. Yagona radikal davo - tug'dirish.

savollar.vinyetka: A 22-year-old woman with type 1 diabetes has vomiting, abdominal pain and Kussmaul breathing. Glucose 520 mg/dL, pH 7.12, K+ 3.1 mEq/L.
savollar.savol: What is the most appropriate next step before starting insulin?
savollar.izoh: DKA: K+ < 3.3 bo'lsa insulin BOSHLANMAYDI - avval kaliy to'ldiriladi (insulin K+ ni hujayraga kiritib, aritmiya chaqiradi). Avval suyuqlik, keyin insulin.

savollar.vinyetka: A 40-year-old woman develops sudden dyspnea and pleuritic chest pain 5 days after hip surgery. HR 118, SpO2 89%. She is hemodynamically stable.
savollar.savol: What is the best initial diagnostic test?
savollar.izoh: O'TE ehtimoli yuqori (operatsiyadan keyin, taxikardiya, gipoksiya) - D-dimer kerak emas, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri KT angiografiya. D-dimer faqat past ehtimolda.

savollar.vinyetka: A 2-year-old has 6 days of fever, bilateral nonexudative conjunctivitis, cracked red lips, cervical lymphadenopathy and swollen hands.
savollar.savol: What is the most appropriate treatment?
savollar.izoh: Kavasaki kasalligi: 5+ kun isitma + 4 belgi. Davolash: IVIG + aspirin (Reye istisno). Asosiy xavf - koronar arteriya anevrizmalari, exokardiografiya shart.

savollar.vinyetka: A 65-year-old man with atrial fibrillation has sudden severe abdominal pain. Physical exam shows minimal tenderness. Lactate is elevated.
savollar.savol: What is the most likely diagnosis?
savollar.izoh: O'tkir mezenterial ishemiya: 'og'riq ko'rikka nomutanosib', ko'pincha AF dan emboliya. Laktat oshadi. Tashxis - KT angiografiya.

savollar.vinyetka: A 28-year-old man on haloperidol develops fever 40.5°C, severe muscle rigidity, confusion and labile blood pressure. CK is 12,000 U/L.
savollar.savol: What is the most appropriate pharmacological treatment besides stopping the drug?
savollar.izoh: Neyroleptik malign sindrom: isitma, 'qo'rg'oshin quvur' rigidligi, KK oshadi. Dori to'xtatiladi, dantrolen yoki bromokriptin. Siproheptadin - serotonin sindromi uchun.

savollar.vinyetka: A 72-year-old woman has syncope on exertion and angina. Exam shows a crescendo-decrescendo systolic murmur radiating to the carotids with a soft S2.
savollar.savol: What is the definitive treatment?
savollar.izoh: Simptomli og'ir aortal stenoz (sinkope, angina, yurak yetishmovchiligi) - klapan almashtirish (SAVR/TAVR). Simptom boshlangach o'lim xavfi tez oshadi.

savollar.vinyetka: A patient with chronic kidney disease has K+ 7.2 mEq/L. ECG shows peaked T waves and widened QRS.
savollar.savol: What is the most appropriate FIRST step?
savollar.izoh: Giperkaliemiya + EKG o'zgarishlari: AVVAL kalsiy glyukonat (miokard membranasini stabillaydi). Keyin insulin+glyukoza, salbutamol, so'ng chiqarish.

savollar.vinyetka: A 67-year-old man has sudden right-sided weakness and aphasia that began 90 minutes ago. Non-contrast CT shows no hemorrhage. BP 170/95.
savollar.savol: What is the best next step?
savollar.izoh: Ishemik insult, 4.5 soat ichida, KT da qon quyilish yo'q - trombolizis (alteplaza). AQB 185/110 dan past bo'lishi kerak. Yirik tomir okklyuziyasida - trombektomiya.

savollar.vinyetka: A 50-year-old man with cirrhosis presents with hematemesis. BP 88/56, HR 124. Two large-bore IVs are placed and fluids started.
savollar.savol: Which medication should be started immediately along with antibiotics?
savollar.izoh: Varikoz qon ketishi: oktreotid (portal bosimni pasaytiradi) + profilaktik antibiotik (seftriakson), 12 soat ichida endoskopik ligatsiya. Beta-bloker - o'tkir davrda emas.

savollar.vinyetka: A 3-week-old firstborn boy has projectile nonbilious vomiting after every feed and is always hungry. An olive-shaped mass is palpable in the epigastrium.
savollar.savol: Which electrolyte abnormality is expected?
savollar.izoh: Pilorik stenoz: HCl qusish bilan yo'qoladi -> gipoxloremik, gipokaliemik metabolik alkaloz. Tashxis - UTT, davolash - piloromiotomiya (elektrolitlarni tuzatgach).

savollar.vinyetka: A 29-year-old woman at 32 weeks has painless bright red vaginal bleeding. Uterus is soft and nontender. Fetal heart tracing is reassuring.
savollar.savol: Which examination must be AVOIDED until placenta position is known?
savollar.izoh: Og'riqsiz qon ketish = platsenta previa ehtimoli. Barmoq bilan qin tekshiruvi kuchli qon ketish chaqirishi mumkin - avval UTT. Og'riqli bo'lsa - platsenta ko'chishi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 25-year-old man has a painless indurated genital ulcer with clean base and painless inguinal lymphadenopathy.
savollar.savol: What is the treatment of choice?
javoblar: Single dose IM benzathine penicillin G
savollar.izoh: Birlamchi zaxm (shankr): og'riqsiz qattiq yara. Davolash - benzatin penitsillin G 2.4 mln IM bir marta. Og'riqli yara - gerpes yoki shankroid (H. ducreyi).

savollar.vinyetka: A hospitalized patient on unfractionated heparin for 6 days has platelets drop from 250,000 to 95,000 and develops a new DVT.
savollar.savol: What is the next best step?
savollar.izoh: HIT (2-tip): 5-10-kunda trombotsitlar 50%+ tushadi, tromboz xavfi. Barcha geparinlar (LMWH ham) to'xtatiladi -> argatroban/fondaparinuks. Varfarin darhol emas.

savollar.vinyetka: A 45-year-old woman has a 2-cm thyroid nodule. TSH is normal. Ultrasound shows a hypoechoic nodule with microcalcifications.
savollar.savol: What is the next best step?
savollar.izoh: Tugun + TSH normal + shubhali UTT belgilari (mikrokalsifikatlar, gipoexogen) - ingichka igna aspiratsiyasi (FNA). TSH past bo'lsa - avval radioyod skani.

savollar.vinyetka: A 19-year-old is found unconscious. Pupils are pinpoint, respiratory rate is 6/min. Needle marks are seen on his arms.
savollar.savol: What is the best immediate treatment?
savollar.izoh: Opioid zaharlanishi: mioz, nafas susayishi, koma - nalokson. Flumazenil benzodiazepinlar uchun (tutqanoq xavfi), atropin - fosfororganik birikmalar uchun.

savollar.vinyetka: A 34-year-old woman has 3 weeks of depressed mood, insomnia, poor appetite, guilt and passive thoughts of death. No history of mania.
savollar.savol: What is the first-line pharmacotherapy?
savollar.izoh: Katta depressiv epizod (2+ hafta, 5+ belgi): birinchi qator - SSRI. Ta'siri 4-6 haftada. Suitsid xavfini doim so'rang; maniya tarixi bo'lsa - bipolyar.

savollar.vinyetka: A patient on lithium for bipolar disorder starts a new antihypertensive. One week later he has coarse tremor, vomiting and confusion.
savollar.savol: Which drug most likely caused lithium toxicity?
savollar.izoh: Tiazidlar (shuningdek IAPF va NSAID) litiy reabsorbsiyasini oshiradi -> toksiklik. Litiy - tor terapevtik oraliq, qondagi darajasini kuzatish kerak.

savollar.vinyetka: A patient with HIV (CD4 = 40) has headache and fever. India ink stain of CSF shows encapsulated yeast.
savollar.savol: What is the initial treatment?
savollar.izoh: Kriptokokk meningiti (CD4<100): induksiya - amfoteritsin B + flutsitozin, keyin flukonazol. Kapsulali achitqi, tush (India ink) bilan ko'rinadi.

savollar.vinyetka: After a midshaft humerus fracture, a patient cannot extend his wrist and has sensory loss over the dorsum of the hand between thumb and index finger.
savollar.savol: Which nerve is injured?
savollar.izoh: Yelka suyagi o'rta qismi sinishi - spiral egat bo'ylab o'tadigan radial nerv. 'Osilgan kaft' (wrist drop). Xirurgik bo'yin sinishi - aksillyar nerv.

bandlar: Squatting / leg raise: increases preload -> most murmurs louder
Standing / Valsalva: HCM and MVP get louder
Handgrip: MR, AR, VSD louder; AS and HCM softer
faktlar.izoh: Manyovrlar shovqinlarni farqlash uchun: Valsalva va turish preloadni kamaytiradi - faqat GKMP va MKP kuchayadi. Qo'l siqish afterloadni oshiradi.

bandlar: Effect: substrate levels rise (e.g., warfarin -> bleeding)
faktlar.izoh: Ingibitorlar boshqa dorilar darajasini oshiradi. Masalan, varfarin + flukonazol = INR oshadi, qon ketish xavfi.

bandlar: Effect: substrate levels fall (e.g., OCP failure)
faktlar.izoh: Induktorlar boshqa dorilar darajasini pasaytiradi: rifampin + kontraseptiv = homiladorlik xavfi. Imtihonda juda ko'p so'raladi.

bandlar: S. pneumoniae, H. influenzae type b, N. meningitidis
E. coli, Salmonella, Klebsiella, group B Strep
Asplenic patients are at highest risk
faktlar.izoh: Kapsulali bakteriyalarni taloq tozalaydi. Splenektomiyadan keyin yoki o'roqsimon anemiyada bu infeksiyalar xavfli - emlash shart.

bandlar: Gaucher: glucocerebrosidase, Gaucher cells, bone crises
Tay-Sachs: hexosaminidase A, cherry-red spot, no HSM
faktlar.izoh: Lizosomal kasalliklar asosan autosom retsessiv (Fabri va Hunter - X-bog'liq). Gilos-qizil dog': Tey-Saks (gepatosplenomegaliyasiz) va Niman-Pik (bilan).

bandlar: Nephritic: hematuria, RBC casts, HTN, oliguria
faktlar.izoh: Nefritik - yallig'lanish (eritrotsitar silindrlar). Nefrotik - podotsit shikasti (katta proteinuriya). Nefrotikda antitrombin III yo'qoladi -> tromboz.

bandlar: MEN2B (RET): Medullary thyroid, Pheo, mucosal neuromas, marfanoid
faktlar.izoh: MEN1 - '3 P'. MEN2A - 2 P + medullyar rak. MEN2B - neyromalar va marfanoid tana. Barchasi autosom dominant.

bandlar: Iron deficiency: ferritin LOW, TIBC HIGH
Anemia of chronic disease: ferritin HIGH, TIBC LOW
Thalassemia: normal iron, target cells, high RBC count
faktlar.izoh: Mikrotsitar anemiyani farqlashda ferritin kalit: past ferritin - temir tanqisligi, yuqori - surunkali kasallik anemiyasi (gepsidin temirni ushlab qoladi).

bandlar: B12 deficiency: dorsal columns + lateral CST (SCD)
Syringomyelia: cape-like loss of pain and temperature
faktlar.izoh: Brown-Sekar: shikastlangan tomonda harakat va chuqur sezgi, qarama-qarshi tomonda og'riq va harorat yo'qoladi (spinotalamik yo'l darhol kesishadi).

bandlar: Type I: IgE, mast cells (anaphylaxis, asthma)
Type II: antibody vs cell (Graves, Goodpasture, AIHA)
Type III: immune complexes (SLE, PSGN, serum sickness)
Type IV: T cells, delayed (PPD, contact dermatitis)
faktlar.izoh: Eslab qolish: ACID - Anafilaktik, Sitotoksik (Cytotoxic), Immun kompleks, Kechikkan (Delayed). IV tip antitelasiz, faqat T-hujayralar.
Antidotlar Step 1 va Step 2 CK da doim chiqadi. Benzodiazepin - flumazenil, opioid - nalokson, temir - deferoksamin, varfarin - K vitamin + PCC.

bandlar: 1-6 h: S. aureus, B. cereus (preformed toxin)
faktlar.izoh: Inkubatsiya vaqti tashxisni tez beradi: bir necha soatda qusish - tayyor toksin (mikrob ko'paymaydi). EHEC (O157:H7) - GUS xavfi, antibiotik berilmaydi.

faktlar.sarlavha: Heart failure: drugs that reduce mortality
faktlar.izoh: Past EF li yurak yetishmovchiligida o'limni kamaytiradigan '4 ustun'. Furosemid faqat simptomlarni yengillatadi, o'limni kamaytirmaydi.

bandlar: AFP: hepatocellular carcinoma, yolk sac tumor
PSA: prostate; beta-hCG: choriocarcinoma, hydatidiform mole
faktlar.izoh: O'sma markerlari asosan tashxis uchun emas, davolashni kuzatish uchun ishlatiladi. Imtihonda ko'pincha 'qaysi o'smani kuzatish uchun' deb so'raladi.

bandlar: Causes: small cell lung cancer, CNS disease, SSRIs, carbamazepine
Treat: fluid restriction; severe -> hypertonic saline (slowly)
faktlar.izoh: SIADH: suv ushlanadi, natriy suyuladi. Natriyni juda tez ko'tarish osmotik demielinizatsiya (ko'prik miyelinolizi) chaqiradi - sutkasiga 8-10 mEq/L dan oshmasin.

bandlar: Trisomy 21 (Down): duodenal atresia, AV canal, early Alzheimer
Most common cause: meiotic nondisjunction (maternal age)
faktlar.izoh: Daun sindromida skriningda: AFP past, hCG yuqori, estriol past, inhibin A yuqori. Edvards - hammasi past. Ona yoshi oshgani sari xavf ortadi.

bandlar: Obstructive: FEV1/FVC < 0.7, TLC normal or high
Restrictive: FEV1/FVC normal or high, TLC low
faktlar.izoh: Spirometriya: obstruktivda havo chiqara olmaydi (KOAH, astma), restriktivda o'pka kengaymaydi. DLCO fibrozni tashqi sabablardan farqlaydi.

bandlar: Crohn: mouth to anus, skip lesions, transmural, granulomas
UC: rectum upward, continuous, mucosal only
faktlar.izoh: Kron - butun devor, 'sakrab' zararlanish, granulyomalar, oqmalar. YaK - to'g'ri ichakdan boshlanadi, uzluksiz, faqat shilliq qavat. Chekish Kronni kuchaytiradi.

bandlar: Antiarrhythmics: class IA and III (sotalol, amiodarone)
Risk: torsades de pointes -> treat with IV magnesium
faktlar.izoh: QT uzayishi 'piruet' tipidagi qorinchalar taxikardiyasiga olib keladi. Davolash - magniy sulfat. Gipokaliemiya va gipomagniemiya xavfni oshiradi.
Faqat anti-HBs musbat - emlangan. Anti-HBs + anti-HBc IgG - kasallikdan tuzalgan. 'Oyna davri'da faqat anti-HBc IgM musbat bo'ladi.

bandlar: ACE inhibitors: renal damage; warfarin: bone deformities
Valproate: neural tube defects; phenytoin: fetal hydantoin
Lithium: Ebstein anomaly; tetracyclines: tooth discoloration
faktlar.izoh: Homiladorlikda varfarin o'rniga geparin (LMWH), IAPF o'rniga labetalol/nifedipin/metildopa beriladi. Valproat - foliy kislota zarur.

bandlar: Systemic symptoms: fever, weight loss, cancer, HIV
Older age (> 50, new) -> think giant cell arteritis
faktlar.izoh: Bosh og'rig'ida 'qizil bayroqlar': birdaniga 'hayotdagi eng kuchli' og'riq - subaraxnoidal qon quyilish (KT, manfiy bo'lsa - lyumbal punksiya).

bandlar: 3. Iodine (SSKI) at least 1 hour AFTER PTU
faktlar.izoh: Tireotoksik kriz: yodni tionamiddan OLDIN berish yangi gormon sintezini kuchaytiradi (Jod-Bazedov). Shuning uchun tartib muhim.

bandlar: PTT: intrinsic (VIII, IX, XI, XII), heparin monitoring
Hemophilia A/B: PTT up, PT normal, platelets normal
von Willebrand: bleeding time up, PTT up or normal
faktlar.izoh: Gemofiliyada qo'shma qon quyilishlar (gemartroz), vWB kasalligida shilliq qavat qon ketishlari. vWB - eng ko'p uchraydigan irsiy qon ivish kasalligi.

bandlar: Displacement: anger redirected to a safer target
Projection: attributing own feelings to others
Reaction formation: acting opposite to true feelings
faktlar.izoh: Bostirish (suppression) ongli va yetuk mexanizm, siqib chiqarish (repression) - ongsiz. Imtihonda vinyetkadan mexanizmni topish so'raladi.

bandlar: Prevalence up -> PPV up, NPV down
Sens/Spec do NOT change with prevalence
faktlar.izoh: Skrining uchun sezgir test (manfiy natija kasallikni istisno qiladi), tasdiqlash uchun spetsifik test. PPV/NPV tarqalishga bog'liq.

bandlar: ARR = control event rate - treatment event rate
faktlar.izoh: Masalan: nazorat guruhida 20%, davolanganda 15% -> ARR = 5%, NNT = 20. Ya'ni bitta hodisani oldini olish uchun 20 bemorni davolash kerak.
'30S ga hujum qil' - aminoglikozidlar, tetratsiklinlar. Qolgan oqsil sintezi ingibitorlari 50S ga ta'sir qiladi. Vankomitsin D-Ala-D-Ala ga bog'lanadi.

bandlar: ST depression V1-V3 + tall R: posterior MI
faktlar.izoh: Pastki MI da doim V4R ni tekshiring - o'ng qorincha infarkti bo'lsa, nitrat berilmaydi. Orqa MI V1-V3 dagi ST depressiyasi bilan namoyon bo'ladi.

bandlar: 2 mo: social smile; 4-6 mo: rolls over, laughs
6 mo: sits with support; 9 mo: pincer grasp, stranger anxiety
2 y: 2-word phrases, runs; 3 y: rides tricycle, copies circle
faktlar.izoh: Rivojlanish bosqichlari Step 2 CK pediatriyada tez-tez chiqadi. Erta tug'ilgan bolalarda 2 yoshgacha 'tuzatilgan yosh' hisobga olinadi.

bandlar: Loop (furosemide): K down, Ca DOWN, ototoxic
Thiazides: K down, Ca UP, glucose/lipids/uric acid up
faktlar.izoh: Esda tuting: 'Loops lose calcium' - halqa diuretiklari kalsiyni yo'qotadi (giperkalsiemiyada ishlatiladi), tiazidlar ushlab qoladi (kalsiy toshlarida foydali).

bandlar: Metformin: lactic acidosis, B12 deficiency, GI upset
GLP-1 agonists: pancreatitis risk, weight loss, nausea
faktlar.izoh: Metformin - 2-tip qandli diabetda birinchi qator, eGFR < 30 da qarshi ko'rsatma. SGLT2 ingibitorlari yurak va buyrakni himoya qiladi.

bandlar: Pleural LDH > 2/3 upper limit of normal serum LDH
faktlar.izoh: Transsudat - yurak yetishmovchiligi, sirroz, nefrotik sindrom. Ekssudat - pnevmoniya, saraton, sil, O'TE. Bitta mezon yetarli.

bandlar: LMN: flaccid weakness, hyporeflexia, atrophy, fasciculations
ALS: both UMN and LMN signs, no sensory loss
Riluzole: modestly prolongs survival in ALS
faktlar.izoh: AMS (amiotrofik lateral skleroz) - ham yuqori, ham pastki motoneyron belgilari, sezgi saqlanadi. SOD1 mutatsiyasi oilaviy shakllarda.

bandlar: Beta-1: heart rate and contractility up (Gs)
faktlar.izoh: 'qiss and qiq till you're siq of sqs': a1-q, a2-i, b1-s, b2-s, M1-q, M2-i, M3-q. Retseptor G-oqsillari Step 1 ning eng ko'p so'raladigan mavzularidan.

bandlar: Obstruction: conjugated + dark urine + pale stools
Gilbert: mild jaundice with fasting or stress
faktlar.izoh: Gilbert sindromi - eng ko'p uchraydigan, zararsiz; UDP-glyukuroniltransferaza faolligi biroz kam. Ochlik va stressda sariqlik paydo bo'ladi.

bandlar: Acute (weeks-months): T cells and/or antibodies, vasculitis
GVHD: donor T cells attack host (skin, liver, GI)
faktlar.izoh: Giperoʻtkir rad etish - qon guruhi nomuvofiqligi, transplantat darhol ko'karib qoladi. O'tkir rad etish immunosupressiyaga javob beradi, surunkali - yo'q.

bandlar: TTP: ADAMTS13 deficiency, fever, neuro symptoms
HUS: EHEC in children, renal failure
DIC: schistocytes + PT/PTT up, fibrinogen down
faktlar.izoh: TTP da trombotsit quyish xavfli - plazmaferez qilinadi. DIC da ivish omillari sarflanadi, shuning uchun PT/PTT uzayadi, TTP/GUS da esa normal.

bandlar: A: airway with cervical spine protection
C: circulation, stop bleeding, 2 large-bore IVs
D: disability (GCS); E: exposure and prevent hypothermia
faktlar.izoh: Shikastlanishda ABCDE tartibi doim saqlanadi. GCS <= 8 - intubatsiya. Taranglashgan pnevmotoraksda rentgen kutilmaydi, darhol igna dekompressiyasi.

bandlar: Competent adult may refuse any treatment
Minors: parental consent, except emergencies, STI, contraception, prenatal care
Use a professional interpreter, not family
Confidentiality exceptions: threat to others, reportable diseases
faktlar.izoh: USMLE etika savollarida eng to'g'ri javob ko'pincha: bemor bilan ochiq gaplashish, uning avtonomiyasini hurmat qilish va professional tarjimon chaqirish.

maslahatlar.sarlavha: USMLE nima va qanday bosqichlardan iborat?
maslahatlar.matn:
USMLE - AQShda shifokor bo'lib ishlash uchun litsenziya imtihoni.

• Step 1 - fundamental fanlar (natija: o'tdi/o'tmadi)
• Step 2 CK - klinik bilimlar (ball beriladi, rezidenturaga qabul uchun eng muhim)
• Step 3 - rezidentura davrida topshiriladi

Xorijiy bitiruvchilar (IMG) uchun ECFMG sertifikati kerak: Step 1 + Step 2 CK + til va klinik ko'nikmalarni tasdiqlash (Pathways).

Ko'pchilik muvaffaqiyatli talabalar ishlatadigan 'oltin uchlik':

1️⃣ First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 - asosiy kitob
2️⃣ UWorld Qbank - savollar banki (eng muhimi!)
3️⃣ Pathoma (patologiya) va Sketchy (mikrobiologiya, farmakologiya)

Resurslarni ko'paytirmang: 3-4 ta yaxshi resursni bir necha marta takrorlash, 10 ta resursni bir marta o'qishdan yaxshiroq.

• 'Timed' va 'Random' rejimida ishlang - imtihon sharoitiga yaqin
• Har blokdan keyin barcha izohlarni o'qing, hatto to'g'ri javob berganlaringizni ham
• Xatolaringizni daftar yoki Anki kartochkalariga yozing
• Foizga emas, o'rganganingizga qarang: birinchi hafta 50% bo'lishi normal

UWorld - bu test emas, o'qish vositasi.

Anki - aqlli kartochkalar ilovasi: unutishga yaqin qolgan narsani aynan o'sha paytda ko'rsatadi.

• Har kuni review'larni o'tkazib yubormang - to'planib qoladi
• Tayyor decklar: AnKing (Step 1/2)
• Kuniga 50-100 ta yangi kartochka yetarli

Kanaldagi high-yield kartochkalarni ham Anki'ga qo'shib boring 😉

Step 1 o'tdi/o'tmadi bo'lgani uchun, endi rezidentura dasturlari Step 2 CK baliga ko'proq qaraydi.

Asosiy resurslar:
• UWorld Step 2 CK Qbank
• Amboss (qo'shimcha savollar va qo'llanma)
• Divine Intervention podkastlari
• NBME va UWSA self-assessment testlari

Step 2 CK da 'keyingi eng to'g'ri qadam' (next best step) tipidagi savollar ko'p.

Imtihondan oldin NBME va UWorld (UWSA) self-assessment testlarini ishlang.

• Har 1-2 haftada bitta test
• Natijalarning o'sishini kuzating
• Oxirgi testlardagi natija o'tish chegarasidan ishonchli darajada yuqori bo'lsa - tayyorsiz

Imtihon sanasini self-assessment natijalariga qarab belgilang, his-tuyg'uga qarab emas.

🕗 08:00-12:00 - 2 blok UWorld (40 savol) + izohlar
🕐 13:00-16:00 - xatolar bo'yicha First Aid / video
🕓 16:30-18:00 - Anki review
🕖 19:00-20:30 - zaif mavzuni takrorlash

Haftada 1 kun dam oling. Uyqu 7-8 soat - xotira uyquda mustahkamlanadi.

Xorijiy tibbiyot bitiruvchisi (IMG) sifatida:

1. Universitetingiz World Directory of Medical Schools ro'yxatida ECFMG talabiga mos bo'lishi kerak
2. Hisob ochish va hujjatlarni tasdiqlatish
3. Step 1 va Step 2 CK ni topshirish
4. Klinik va kommunikativ ko'nikmalar hamda ingliz tili talablarini bajarish (Pathways)

Talablar yildan-yilga o'zgaradi - doim rasmiy ecfmg.org saytini tekshiring.

• Avval oxirgi jumlani (savolni) o'qing, keyin vinyetkani
• Yosh, jins, asosiy shikoyat va vaqtni belgilang
• Javoblarga qaramasdan o'z javobingizni o'ylang
• Ikki variant orasida qolsangiz - vinyetkada qaysi ma'lumot ulardan birini istisno qilishini qidiring
• Bitta savolga 90 soniyadan ortiq vaqt sarflamang

USMLE - marafon, sprint emas.

• Haftada kamida bir kun to'liq dam
• Har kuni 20-30 daqiqa jismoniy faollik
• Natijangizni boshqalar bilan solishtirmang
• Kichik maqsadlar qo'ying va bajarganingizda o'zingizni rag'batlantiring

Agar uzoq vaqt kayfiyat tushkun bo'lsa - mutaxassisga murojaat qilish kuchsizlik emas.

First Aid - ma'lumotnoma, darslik emas.

• Birinchi o'qishda tushunmagan mavzularni video (Boards & Beyond, Pathoma) orqali o'rganing
• UWorld'da duch kelgan har bir yangi faktni First Aid'ning tegishli sahifasiga yozib qo'ying
• Imtihongacha First Aid'ni kamida 2-3 marta to'liq takrorlang

Ko'pchilik biostatistika va etikani e'tiborsiz qoldiradi, lekin ular Step 1 va Step 2 CK da sezilarli ulushga ega.

O'rganish kerak:
• Sezgirlik, spetsifiklik, PPV, NPV
• NNT, ARR, RR, OR
• Tadqiqot turlari va sistematik xatolar (bias)
• I va II tur xatolar

Bir hafta sarflab, bu mavzularni yaxshilab o'rganing - har imtihonda foyda beradi.

maslahatlar.sarlavha: Imtihon kuni: nimalarga e'tibor berish kerak?
maslahatlar.matn:
• Bir kun oldin yangi narsa o'qimang - dam oling
• Prometric markaziga 30 daqiqa oldin boring
• Pasportni unutmang (ismingiz ro'yxatdagi bilan bir xil bo'lishi kerak)
• Tanaffus vaqtini rejalashtiring: suv va yengil ovqat oling
• Qiyin blokdan keyin vahimaga tushmang - hamma bloklar qiyin tuyuladi

Rezidenturaga qabul qilishda AQSh klinik tajribasi (USCE) va tavsiya xatlari (LoR) juda muhim.

Turlari:
• Clerkship / elective (talabalik davrida)
• Externship
• Observership (faqat kuzatish)

Amaliy (hands-on) tajriba observership'dan qadrliroq. Tavsiya xatlarini AQShdagi shifokorlardan olishga harakat qiling.

USMLE savollari uzun va tez o'qishni talab qiladi.

• Har kuni ingliz tilida tibbiy matn o'qing (UpToDate, Medscape)
• Podkastlarni tinglang (Divine Intervention, Emma Holliday)
• Savollarni o'qish tezligingizni o'lchang: bir vinyetka uchun 1 daqiqadan oshmasin

Til kuchli bo'lsa, vaqt yetmaslik muammosi yo'qoladi.

Har bir xato javobni yozib boring:

• Mavzu
• Nega xato qildim? (bilmadim / unutdim / noto'g'ri o'qidim / ikkilandim)
• To'g'ri qoida bir jumlada

Har hafta oxirida daftarni qayta ko'rib chiqing. Ko'pincha xatolarning yarmi bilim emas, o'qishdagi e'tiborsizlik sababli bo'ladi.

Ha, agar to'g'ri tashkil etilsa:

• 2-4 kishi, bir xil maqsadda
• Har biri bitta mavzuni boshqalarga tushuntiradi - o'rgatish eng yaxshi o'rganish
• Birgalikda UWorld bloki ishlab, izohlarni muhokama qiling

Kanal izohlarida ham sherik topishingiz mumkin 🤝

2022-yildan beri Step 1 faqat 'Pass/Fail'. Bu degani:

• Step 2 CK bali endi asosiy raqobat mezoni
• Tadqiqot, nashrlar va USCE ahamiyati oshdi
• Step 1 ni birinchi urinishda o'tish muhim - muvaffaqiyatsiz urinish rezyumeda qoladi

Shuning uchun Step 1 ni shoshilmasdan, yaxshi tayyorlanib topshiring.

Har kuni USMLE Pulsi'da:

🧠 4 ta klinik savol (viktorina) - javob bering, keyin izohni o'qing
⚡️ 4 ta high-yield kartochka - saqlab qo'ying yoki Anki'ga qo'shing
💡 maslahat va ECFMG yangiliklari

Do'stlaringizga ham ulashing - birgalikda o'qish osonroq!

Qiyin kunlarda o'zingizga eslatib qo'ying, nega bu yo'lni tanlagansiz.

Har bir to'g'ri yechilgan savol - kelajakda to'g'ri qo'yilgan tashxis. Har bir o'rganilgan fakt - kimningdir sog'lig'i.

Bugungi kichik qadam ertangi katta natijaga olib keladi. Davom eting! 💪
